description_en: Modifies the network type of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于修改实例网络类型
kebab_example: aliyun hologram update-instance-network-type --instance-id hgprecn-cn-lbj35pw74002 --network-types Internet,VPCSingleTunnel --vpc-id vpc-t4netc3y5etlondfb5ra7 --vswitch-id vsw-2vccsiymtqr9aavew0vo3 --vpc-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpc-owner-id 1999365732646672 --any-tunnel-to-single-tunnel true --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateInstanceNetworkType

parameters.description_en: The network types to enable. The order of the network types does not matter. For example, if an instance has the Internet, Intranet, and VPCSingleTunnel network types enabled, disable the Internet network type by specifying \`Intranet,VPCSingleTunnel\`.
parameters.description_zh:
希望开启的网络类型列表，已有网络类型的组合，顺序无关。
比如已经开启公网、内网和VPCSingleTunnel，如要关闭公网，
则把公网类型去掉即可，即传递 “Intranet, VPCSingleTunnel” 。
parameters.help_en: The network types to enable. The order of the network types does not matter. For example, if an instance has the Internet, Intranet, and VPCSingleTunnel network types enabled, disable the Internet network type by specifying \`Intranet,VPCSingleTunnel\`
parameters.help_zh:

parameters.description_en: The region ID of the VPC.
parameters.help_en: The region ID of the VPC
parameters.name: vpc_region_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the VPC.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the VPC
parameters.name: vpc_owner_id

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to change the network type from AnyTunnel to SingleTunnel. This parameter is not applicable to new instances. Keep the default value of null.
parameters.description_zh: 是否从AnyTunnel转换成SingleTunnel（新实例无用，默认为null即可）
